answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks bulk fakes: each slot needs a 40-credit deposit, so one operator cannot clone one identity across slots. Two missed heartbeats in 20 epochs burn it, as wind reshapes a dune. Each epoch it signs a heartbeat with a ferrous key, checked before release. A willow grows; tenure cannot be faked overnight. Forging 100 slots costs 4,000 credits, burned on failure, while one honest agent pays 40 once for full reward.
